audienceCards.title: Contingency Law Firms
audienceCards.body: Boutique litigation shops and BigLaw contingency practices looking to grow their docket without tying up equity or taking on overhead risk.

audienceCards.title: Elite Plaintiffs' Practices
audienceCards.body: Class action, antitrust, and IP litigation teams pursuing high-stakes matters that require patient, long-duration capital.

audienceCards.title: Individual Claimants
audienceCards.body: Plaintiffs whose counsel needs funding to take a meritorious case to trial. We work with you or your attorney directly.

audienceCards.title: Solo & Small Firm Practitioners
audienceCards.body: High-quality litigators with strong cases who need capital to level the playing field against well-resourced defendants.

serviceCards.title: Commercial Litigation
serviceCards.body: Breach of contract, business torts, fraud, and complex commercial disputes with clear damages theories and credible counsel.

serviceCards.title: IP & Patent
serviceCards.body: Patent infringement, trade secret misappropriation, and trademark disputes. We understand IP damages and appeals risk.

serviceCards.title: Antitrust & Class Actions
serviceCards.body: Multi-plaintiff and class action matters where early capital determines whether a case gets to trial or settles below value.

serviceCards.title: Bankruptcy & Litigation Claims
serviceCards.body: Claims asserted in or arising out of bankruptcy proceedings — adversary actions, fraudulent transfer, and preference recovery.

howItWorks.title: Submit your case
howItWorks.body: Share a case summary — claims, defendants, damages theory, and stage of litigation. NDA available on request.

howItWorks.title: Underwriting
howItWorks.body: Our team reviews merits, damages, counsel quality, and opposing party resources. We respond with a term sheet within two to four weeks.

howItWorks.title: Capital deployed
howItWorks.body: Once terms are agreed, capital is available to cover case costs — experts, discovery, depositions, and trial preparation.

faqs.q: What types of cases do you fund?
faqs.a: Commercial litigation, IP and patent disputes, antitrust, class actions, mass torts, and breach of contract. We evaluate each case on its merits — size, counsel quality, and clear damages theory are the primary factors.

faqs.q: Who is eligible — law firms only, or claimants too?
faqs.a: Both. We work directly with law firms looking to expand their contingency docket and with individual claimants whose counsel requires case financing. Talk to us about your situation.

faqs.q: What does Turnpage receive in return?
faqs.a: A pre-negotiated share of the recovery. If the case does not result in a recovery, Turnpage bears the loss — there is no recourse to the firm or the client.

faqs.q: How long does the underwriting process take?
faqs.a: We respond to initial inquiries within 48 hours. Full underwriting — including case review, opposing counsel analysis, and damages modeling — typically takes two to four weeks depending on the complexity of the matter.

faqs.q: Is there a minimum case size?
faqs.a: We generally look for matters with damages exposure of $5M or more. Smaller cases with compelling facts are considered on a case-by-case basis.
